span.p:
APP_USER
# id
username [UQ]
password
role
bio
avatar_image
avatar_content_type

div.style: color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MUSIC_WALL
# id
name
wallpaper
wall_color
owner_id [FK → APP_USER.id]

div.style: color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MUSIC_SECTION
# id
name
note_color
wall_id [FK → MUSIC_WALL.id]

div.style: color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MUSIC_ITEM
# id
title
artist
item_type
status
section_id [FK → MUSIC_SECTION.id]
catalog_track_id [FK → TRACK.id, NULL]
catalog_album_id [FK → ALBUM.id, NULL]

div.style: color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ALBUM
# id
title
release_year
cover_url
artist_id [FK → ARTIST.id]
[UQ artist_id + title]

div.style: color: rgb(18, 63, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TRACK
# id
title
duration_seconds
artist_id [FK → ARTIST.id]
album_id [FK → ALBUM.id, NULL]

Logical XOR rule:
exactly one of catalog_track_id
or catalog_album_id must be set.
